name: ventricular septal defect
description: A communication between the left and right ventricles allowing intracardiac shunting. Described by presence, size, location, shunt direction, hemodynamic impact, and associated cardiac findings.

attributes.name: presence
attributes.description: Whether a ventricular septal defect is identified on the examination.

values.name: present
values.description: Defect is seen.

values.name: absent
values.description: No defect identified.

attributes.name: size mm
attributes.description: Maximum measured diameter of the defect on imaging.

attributes.name: size category
attributes.description: Categorical estimate of defect size commonly used clinically.

values.name: small
values.description: Typically <3 mm or hemodynamically insignificant.

values.name: moderate
values.description: Typically 3-6 mm with potential hemodynamic effect.

values.name: large
values.description: Typically >6 mm and often hemodynamically significant.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Anatomic location of the defect within the ventricular septum.

values.name: perimembranous
values.description: Adjacent to the membranous septum; most common VSD type.

values.name: muscular
values.description: Within the muscular septum (trabecular/apical).

values.name: inlet
values.description: Near the tricuspid valve/inlet portion of the septum.

values.name: outlet supracristal
values.description: Subpulmonary or outlet region (supracristal).

values.name: apical
values.description: Located toward the apex of the heart.

attributes.name: shunt direction
attributes.description: Direction of blood flow through the defect at the time of imaging.

values.name: left to right
values.description: Typical direction when pulmonary resistance is lower than systemic.

values.name: right to left
values.description: Seen with severe pulmonary hypertension or eisenmenger physiology.

values.name: bidirectional
values.description: Flow is both left-to-right and right-to-left at different times or phases.

attributes.name: shunt severity
attributes.description: Estimated volume or physiologic impact of the intracardiac shunt.

values.name: trivial
values.description: Minimal or clinically insignificant shunt.

values.name: mild
values.description: Small shunt with limited hemodynamic effect.

values.name: moderate
values.description: Shunt likely to have measurable hemodynamic consequences.

values.name: severe
values.description: Large shunt with significant hemodynamic impact.

attributes.name: pulmonary hypertension
attributes.description: Estimated pulmonary arterial pressure or hypertensive effect related to the shunt.

values.name: none
values.description: No imaging evidence of elevated pulmonary pressures.

values.name: mild
values.description: Mild elevation of pulmonary pressures.

values.name: moderate
values.description: Moderate elevation of pulmonary pressures.

values.name: severe
values.description: Marked elevation; may indicate advanced pulmonary vascular disease.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Number of discrete ventricular septal defects identified.

values.name: single
values.description: One defect identified.

values.name: multiple
values.description: More than one defect (fenestrated or multiple VSDs).

attributes.name: associated lesions
attributes.description: Other cardiac findings commonly reported with VSD; multiple may be selected.

values.name: none
values.description: No additional associated cardiac lesions identified.

values.name: aortic valve prolapse
values.description: Prolapse of aortic cusp into VSD.

values.name: tricuspid regurgitation
values.description: Regurgitation of the tricuspid valve.

values.name: endocarditis
values.description: Infective involvement of valve or septal tissue.

values.name: atrial septal defect
values.description: Coexisting ASD.

values.name: patent ductus arteriosus
values.description: Coexisting PDA.

values.name: other congenital cardiac anomaly
values.description: Any other congenital cardiac lesion (specify separately).

values.name: eisenmenger physiology
values.description: Advanced pulmonary vascular disease with reversed or bidirectional shunt.

attributes.name: repair status
attributes.description: Status of prior or current intervention for the VSD.

values.name: unrepaired
values.description: No prior repair.

values.name: surgically repaired
values.description: Prior open surgical repair reported.

values.name: device closed
values.description: Transcatheter device closure in place.

values.name: residual defect
values.description: Residual or recurrent defect after prior intervention.
